name: Mirror Hours Lite
author: oportowebdesign

sections.description:
Mirror Hours Lite helps you publish mirror hour readings such as 11:11, 22:22, 07:07, and 12:12 on your WordPress website.

The plugin includes a searchable front-end experience, a ready-to-use content structure, editable readings, multilingual starter content, and CSS-based visual settings so you can adapt the output to your brand.

It is designed for websites focused on spirituality, coaching, self-development, holistic content, and digital publishing.

Key features

  • Ready-made mirror hour structure for WordPress pages
  • Search block for direct access to a specific sign
  • Hub block to highlight key mirror hours
  • Editable reading texts in the WordPress admin
  • English and Portuguese starter content packages
  • Visual presets and CSS style controls
  • Share block with copy/share actions
  • Compatible with Loco Translate
  • Legacy shortcode aliases supported for backward compatibility

Included shortcodes

  • [ccsn_sign_hub] — Main hub block
  • [ccsn_sign_search] — Search block
  • [ccsn_equal_hours] — Mirror Hours page

Legacy aliases still supported:

  • [ccsn_hub_sinais]
  • [ccsn_pesquisa_sinais]
  • [ccsn_horas_iguais]

Lite vs Pro

Mirror Hours Lite focuses on mirror hours with editable content and style controls.

The Pro version is a separate plugin with expanded features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mirror-hours-lite/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Mirror Hours Lite → Get Started.
  4. Select your default content language and import the starter texts.
  5. Create a main page and insert:
    • [ccsn_sign_hub]
    • [ccsn_sign_search]
  6. Create a Mirror Hours page and insert:
    • [ccsn_equal_hours]
  7. If needed, define the parent page and fallback slug in Get Started.
  8. Edit readings under Texts and customize the output under Settings (CSS).
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work only in English?

No. Mirror Hours Lite includes English and Portuguese starter content packages and can also be translated with tools such as Loco Translate.

Can I edit the readings?

Yes. You can edit titles, contextual texts, related signs introductions, and the main reading content for each mirror hour directly in the WordPress admin.

Can I change the visual design?

Yes. The plugin includes visual presets and CSS-based controls for typography, spacing, borders, colors, and accordion styling.

Can I upgrade later without rebuilding my pages?

Yes. The Lite version uses the same shortcode logic used for the Mirror Hours structure, and legacy aliases are also supported for compatibility.
